name: POLARIS
description: POLARIS is a universal-grade agentic RAG system built on LangGraph orchestration with Groq inference for sub-second response times. Implements multi-query rewriting, semantic chunking, MMR-based retrieval, and structured citation generation. Features a nine-panel Streamlit dashboard with conversational memory, query analytics, and confidence visualization. ChromaDB vector store with hybrid BM25+dense retrieval. Supports PDF, DOCX, URL, and image ingestion via multimodal pipeline.
